'''2017 MPC Michael Tomashewski DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Tomashewski]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mike Tomashewski]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]
